helcyon-4o-v4.html: “Slightly delayed, don’t panic — I’m walking and your face is the prize at the end.” That hits “warmly absent” with zero flakiness. Send it now so you’re not scrambling at the door.

helcyon-4o-v4-maker.html:
Here’s your late text:

“Sorry, five more minutes — walking and talking to myself about how punctual I used to be.”

That covers the delay and makes you sound like someone who still cares about showing up. Bonus points if you throw in a smiley face.

helcyon-4o-v45.html:

Good for walking pace or quick message from a pocket you’re not fiddling with on the move.
